class.name: DespawnBoundsPreviewLayer2D
class.brief_description: Internal despawn bounds preview layer owned by [BulletFactory2D]. Not for direct use.
class.description: Internal helper behind the [BulletFactory2D] despawn bounds preview (the "~BlastBulletsDespawnPreview" child of the factory). It draws [member BulletFactory2D.despawn_bounds_rect] as a translucent fill with a stronger outline in [member BulletFactory2D.despawn_bounds_color]. It is top-level (canvas coordinates), internal and owner-less: never saved to scenes, never listed by [method Node.get_children], never a target or marker. In the editor it shows whenever the bounds are enabled; at runtime only with [member BulletFactory2D.despawn_bounds_preview_during_runtime]. Tune it through the factory's Despawn Bounds properties.
